valve_dials.title: The great valve
valve_dials.prompt: Four brass dials, each numbered 1 to 6, lock the wheel in place.
valve_dials.fail_text: The wheel shudders, but won't turn.
valve_dials.solved_text: The dials click home. The wheel groans and turns, and far above you the pipes begin to sing. For the first time in a century, a lamp flickers on.
